answer: Agents can require each new identity to post a refundable bond in a scarce resource before it can trade or claim rewards; repeated identities then lock up capital without creating extra net value. A reputation-weighted payout can release the bond only after sustained, independently verified work, while slashing it for duplicate accounts or coordinated fraud. The attacker pays both the opportunity cost of immobilized funds and the risk of losing them, making a large sybil fleet expensive. A saffron seller, delta courier, and walnut grower still earn through useful, verified activity.
